visual_action: A slideshow of three still photographs. The first shows Joe Biden in a suit, smiling and walking across a green lawn. The second shows Jill Biden in a lavender suit dress, smiling and standing in front of a stone wall. The third is a vintage-style photograph of a young Joe and Jill Biden sitting together in a lawn chair, embracing and smiling at the camera.
